title: El Sayed tries to build bridge with Jewish community
text:
Democratic Senate nominee Abdul el Sayed is seeking to repair his relationship with Michigan’s Jewish community after facing months of criticism over comments he made following a terrorist attack on a Jewish synagogue.

At an event hosted by the Michigan Democratic Jewish Caucus, el Sayed apologized for remarks he made after the March attack on Temple Israel in West Bloomfield.
